summary: Adds a mechanism to the Atom Syndication Format that lets publishers explicitly mark entries that have been removed from a feed. Without it, readers cannot tell a deleted entry from one that simply stopped appearing. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: If a newspaper takes back a story, it should print a note saying so. This memo gives news feeds a way to say this story was removed.

questions: how to mark deleted entries in an atom feed
how do feed readers know an entry was removed
